subject: general
question: In international sports, Lovlina Borgohain represents India in which sports?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Boxing.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain is an Indian boxer.**
 
• She achieved a **bronze medal at the 2020 Olympic Games** in the women's welterweight event, becoming only the **third Indian boxer to achieve a medal at the Olympics.**
 
• 23-year-old Lovlina Borgohain brings cheer to the country, mainly her **hometown in Golaghat district,** as she takes a medal for boxing at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abhinav Apjit Bindra** is an Indian **Olympic gold medallist**, and retired **sport shooter.**​
 
• **Limba Ram** is an Indian archer who has represented India in three Olympics.
 
• Outstanding **Indian Judo players** include **Narendra Singh, Cawas Billimoria, Poonam Chopra Akram Shah, Angom Anita Chanu, Khumujam Tombi Devi, Avtar Singh, Garima Chaudhary.**
